indicator_definition: This indicator measures the proportion of individuals using the internet in the last three months, as a percentage of total population. Data are collected through the EU ICT Usage Survey.
rationale: Internet access enables participation in the digital economy and access to information. Progress means a growing share of the population using the internet regularly.
methodology_characteristics: Data are collected through the annual EU Survey on ICT Usage in Households and by Individuals. Published annually by Eurostat.
indicator_name: Internet users as share of population
graph_title: Internet users as share of population
